parsed.answer: To change the email, use PATCH /v1/customers/{customerId}/contact-details (operationId: updateContactDetails), which requires email in the request body and returns the updated Customer on a 200 response. To confirm the change, use GET /v1/customers (operationId: searchCustomers) and query by the email address, or rely on the Customer object returned in the PATCH 200 response.
